scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem with explicit hypotheses, algebraic decomposition, integral Gram positivity, strict-negative-type inheritance and high-precision sanity checks; all computational experiments finite.

title: Sharp generalized roundness of height-two regular rooted trees and an inverse-square branching law
